mentions.name: Rust voxel engine
mentions.description: A high-performance voxel engine written from scratch in Rust as a hobby project. It features cubic chunks, a full lighting engine, mostly-implemented multiplayer, and unsigned integer math throughout (except rotation and rendering), designed to handle heavy simulation while being non-deterministic.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on what I hope to be a high-performance voxel engine from scratch in Rust in my free-time.
